user.title: Set up Outage Log
user.description: Choose the sensor that reports whether grid power is present. Battery sensors are optional and only enrich the journal.

data.grid_state_present: State that means grid power is present

data_description.grid_entity: A binary sensor that is on while the grid supplies power.
data_description.grid_state_present: Select whether on or off means the grid is present.
data_description.battery_soc_entity: Optional sensor with battery state of charge in percent.
data_description.battery_power_entity: Optional sensor with battery power in watts.
data_description.battery_capacity_kwh: Used to convert state-of-charge changes into energy. Default: 5.0 kWh.
data_description.notify_service: Optional notify service, for example notify.mobile_app_phone.
data_description.min_duration_seconds: Outages shorter than this are ignored. Default: 30 seconds.

error.invalid_entity: One of the selected entities does not exist or has the wrong domain.
